lines.zh: 我红得像烤过的陶，走得很快。
lines.en: Red as fired clay. I walk quickly.

lines.zh: 我冲在最前面，不回头看。
lines.en: I'm at the very front. Never look back.
Every step lands hard.

lines.zh: 红色的泥，掉了也是红的。
lines.en: Red clay. Even the crumbs are red.

lines.zh: 我朝战场的方向去，不绕路。
lines.en: Toward battle. No detours.
My arms swing wide.
Walking and hunting for a face.
Red prints trail behind me.

lines.zh: 我的脚踝不好弯，走起来直。
lines.en: Stiff ankles. My legs stay straight.
Marks of firing on me.
Long strides toward you.

lines.zh: 我不停，停了就没有气势。
lines.en: I don't stop. Stopping loses momentum.
I stand. Fists closed.
I chose red myself.

lines.zh: 我等战斗开始，等得不耐烦。
lines.en: Waiting for the fight. Impatiently.

lines.zh: 身上的泥被火烤过，很硬。
lines.en: Fired clay. Very hard.

lines.zh: 我拍了拍胸口，掉下红渣。
lines.en: I strike my chest. Red flakes fall.

lines.zh: 我的声音很粗，像石头磨石头。
lines.en: My voice is rough. Stone on stone.

lines.zh: 我看着我的同伴，也是泥的。
lines.en: I look at my companions. Clay too.
No fight to be had, so I count red clay flecks.
I weigh it — heavier than I am.
I don't fear breaking. I fear idleness.

lines.zh: 你看着还行，值得打一场。
lines.en: You look decent. Worth a fight.

lines.zh: 我的脸没表情，但我在笑。
lines.en: No expression. But I'm grinning.
Thinner than me. Doesn't matter.
I beckon you over.
Your grip is wrong.

lines.zh: 我的红色在你眼里很刺。
lines.en: My red stings your eyes.
You're not backing off. Good. Come.

lines.zh: 我们之间这几步，很快就没了。
lines.en: These few steps will be gone soon.

lines.zh: 我看着你的脚，那里先动。
lines.en: I watch your feet. They move first.
You smiled. So can I.
I roll my neck once.
Ready? I won't wait.
A piece came off. No pain.
My red clay shell splits and shows what's inside.
A scrape through the red.
Not heavy. Again.
I grin. My clay lips split.
I'll remember that punch.
Back on my feet. Still fighting.

lines.zh: 身上又裂了一道，无所谓。
lines.en: Another crack. Doesn't matter.
The more I'm hit, the angrier I get.
I straighten up and press the broken pieces back in.

lines.zh: 红土的拳头，先试试你的甲。
lines.en: A red clay fist tries your armor first.
Holding it up. Just what I want.

lines.zh: 木棍和燧石才能升级我。
lines.en: Sticks and flint upgrade me.
That gives me nothing.
Drop it. Pick up a weapon.
Red clay knuckles crackle.
Steady your hand. I'm coming.

lines.zh: 这东西可比你手里的有意思。
lines.en: More interesting than what you hold.
Backing up while holding it. No presence.
Not needed. Wanted.
You hit me. I don't yield.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的肩膀响了一声。
lines.en: My shoulder clicked.

lines.zh: 我们是两块陶撞在一起。
lines.en: Two pieces of fired clay meeting.
You stepped back. I step forward.

lines.zh: 我的红渣蹭到你的衣服上了。
lines.en: My red dust is on your clothes.
Don't crowd. I'm swinging.
That made me more eager.
Lighter than me. You went further.

lines.zh: 我肩膀上一块泥掉下来。
lines.en: A chunk of clay fell from my shoulder.
That counts as a start.
Fighting is all I know.
This body was shaped from clay.
What do you want? Say it plainly.
A fight beats this talk.
Stand back. My fists are big.
I don't know these customs.
Another red one? Let's fight.
I have my fists. Enough.
Back off. Don't get in the way.
I'm waiting here for the fight.

lines.zh: 一把攥住，红指印留在上面。
lines.en: I snatch it up, leaving red fingerprints on it.
Wrong weight. Too light.

lines.zh: 我举起来，当作武器试了试。
lines.en: I try it as a weapon.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我踩了过去。
lines.en: Something on the ground. I stepped on it.
I grip. Red dust falls.
Yours? I'll use it.
I could strap this to my hand.
I toss it aside. Useless.
A stone. Good for smashing.
I hold it up for the others.
You're ahead of me. Enough.
My fist is up.
I move first in this one.

lines.zh: 你的位置，我一眼就看到了。
lines.en: Your spot. One glance.
I hate waiting. Coming.

lines.zh: 红色的我在这片灰里最显眼。
lines.en: This red stands out in the grey.
My brick-red feet plant themselves in the dirt.
You retreat. I charge after.

lines.zh: 红盔的影子，只落在你身上。
lines.en: My red helm's shadow falls only on you.

lines.zh: 红盔上的毛，朝你竖起来。
lines.en: The wool on my red helm bristles toward you.

lines.zh: 红泥就算碎了，也会黏住你。
lines.en: Even shattered, red clay clings to you.
My companions are watching from behind.
Stop standing. Swing.

lines.zh: 红色的黏土，冲起来最显眼。
lines.en: Red clay is the most visible on a charge.
I stride in, hard.
You retreat. I don't circle. Straight.
My fist is loaded behind me.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡第一下，挡不了第二下。
lines.en: Armor stops the first. Not the second.
I cracked a floor tile.

lines.zh: 你往侧面躲，我转身很快。
lines.en: You dodge sideways. I turn fast.
The red shadow comes closer.
You pant. My fists don't.

lines.zh: 这一片空地正适合冲锋。
lines.en: Open ground. Perfect for a charge.
My shoulder's turned in.
I'm coming in. Stop me.
Stop dodging. You can't.
Here I come. Plant your feet.
All my weight behind this.
Stand there and I'll hit you.

lines.zh: 我是红色染料染出来的兵。
lines.en: Red dye is what made me a soldier.
That shattered my knuckles.
You went back three or four steps.
These red clay hands grip tighter than iron.
Red dust and blood both flew.
You blocked. Your wrist bent wrong.
That was my cleanest punch.
My fist can't stop.
You hit the wall.
That one used both hands.
One punch put you on a knee.
I don't stop. I keep swinging.

lines.zh: 这一击把我的手臂打裂了。
lines.en: That cracked my own arm.
A coat of red earth on you.

lines.zh: 我的拳头举起来又落下。
lines.en: My fist rises and falls.
Now you understand.

lines.zh: 我从土里被捏出来，红的。
lines.en: Shaped from the earth. Red.
The moment I stood, I wanted a fight.
The red still carries heat.
I land. A ring of red marks.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，找最近的对手。
lines.en: I raise my head. Nearest opponent.

lines.zh: 我的同伴在我旁边，也是泥的。
lines.en: Companions beside me. Clay too.

lines.zh: 这块地，从现在起是战场。
lines.en: This ground is a battlefield now.
I clench. My knuckles crack.

lines.zh: 红色是我给自己的记号。
lines.en: Red is the mark I gave myself.
Step by step, out of the pit.

lines.zh: 我一身红，是从染料缸里出来的。
lines.en: My red came out of a dye vat.
I'm here. Not leaving.
Fire makes me harder.
Fell. A leg folded.

lines.zh: 水里泡软了，我拳头也软了。
lines.en: Soaked soft. My fists too.

lines.zh: 炸得我胸口开了个大洞。
lines.en: The blast opened my chest.

lines.zh: 箭穿过手臂，红泥簌簌掉。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and red clay crumbles off.

lines.zh: 这光让我身体里的泥在响。
lines.en: That power makes my clay ring.
Drying out. Shedding fast.
Lightning lit the red for an instant.
Falling. I broke on the way down.
